The vibrio dataset as a character matrix

Source: R/matrix.R
vibrioMatrix.Rd

Recodes the vibrio consensus matrix of Noguerola & Blanch (2008) into the character matrix keyFromMatrix() takes: + and (+) (mostly positive) become "+", - and (-) become "-", the variable results v and d become "+/-", and ND (not determined) and the one blank cell become NA.

Usage

vibrioMatrix()

Value

A data frame with 74 rows: Taxon, then the 45 tests.

See also

vibrioKey()

Examples

m <- vibrioMatrix()
m[1:4, 1:4]
#>             Taxon Arginine dihydrolase (moller) Lysine decarboxylase(Moller)
#> 1     V.aerogenes                             +                            -
#> 2   V.aestuarinus                             +                          +/-
#> 3   V.agarivorans                             -                            -
#> 4 V.alginolyticus                             -                            +
#>   Ornithine decarboxylase(moller)
#> 1                               -
#> 2                               -
#> 3                               -
#> 4                               +
table(unlist(m[-1]), useNA = "ifany")
#> 
#>    +  +/-    - <NA> 
#> 1164  282 1495  389
